treatment: main Mac Metal screen with explicit 256 MiB cache cap
scope: Three complete request sets. This within-treatment score is separate from ARC-Easy and the GCP estimated profiler score.
grading_rules: Each original rubric criterion keeps its original weight; passed/failed decisions are manual, not regex matches.
Read answer and reasoning_content in full. Award quality points only for substantive delivered final-answer content. Hidden intermediate calculations do not earn points.
Empty final fields and final prefixes with no substantive requested answer receive zero for every criterion, including avoidance-of-error criteria.
A substantive but truncated final answer can receive credit only for completed criteria actually present; truncation and completion counts remain explicit.
Unresolved contradictory claims fail the affected criterion. A correct final expression may earn its own criterion even if a separately scored derivation criterion fails.
Numerical totals remain provisional pending independent review; they are neither official judge scores nor estimates of unbounded-budget capability.
comparison_caveats: All three share the recorded 1024-token output budget, which includes reasoning. The two reasoning models frequently exhaust it before final answers.
Completion means a finished final text was returned; it does not mean that text is correct.
DNA analogy and corrective-pedagogy criteria require reviewer judgment; rationales are retained for cross-review.
The earlier uncapped-cache pilot control is excluded; only the main 256 MiB response files are assessed.
